imports:
import BanditRLProof.OnlineConvexSums
import BanditRLProof.OnlineSubgradientDifferentiability

/-!
# Source-faithful finite sums of subgradients

Orabona, Online Learning: A Modern Introduction Using Convex Optimization,
arXiv:1912.13213v10, Theorem 2.23, printed pages 17–18.
The unconditional inclusion needs proper components. The reverse direction
constructs the actual Minkowski witness under one common point in the last
effective domain and every other domain interior. Its epigraph separation
producer does not assume a decomposition or dual attainment.

The source equality keeps closedness of all components, though the internal
binary separation helper proves a stronger statement without that premise.
Query finiteness is derived from the aggregate support, not a terminal premise.
The singleton family requires only a nonempty effective domain.
-/
